source_documents.title: Quantitative Design of Bright Fluorophores and AIEgens via the Accurate Prediction of Twisted Intramolecular Charge Transfer (TICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: the rotation barriers and driving energies of P4 (ERB = 0.38 and EDE = -0.14 eV) and P5 (ERB = 0.27 and EDE = -0.24 eV) are larger than that of P2 (ERB = 0.23 and EDE = -0.36 eV)
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2, P4 and P5
reference_evidence_units.statement: P2 has a 0.23 eV N-TICT barrier and -0.36 eV driving energy; P4 has 0.38 and -0.14 eV, predicting stronger resistance in P4.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Target-specific numbers are separated; no claim that P4 entirely prevents TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the quantum yields of P4 (Φ = 0.38) and P5 (Φ = 0.33) are about twice than that of P2 (Φ = 0.17)
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2, P4 and P5
reference_evidence_units.statement: PBS quantum yield is 0.38 for P4, versus P2's 0.17.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparative brightness improvement is not an aggregation experiment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the relative fluorescence intensity of P2 and P4 gradually increases when the water/glycerol ratio changed from 10/0 to 2/8.
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2 and P4
reference_evidence_units.statement: Both compounds brighten as glycerol increases.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Polarity changes together with viscosity; donor strength similarity is a control argument, not exact invariance of all solvent interactions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: P2 and P4 exhibit comparable quantum yield (Φ = 0.48 vs. 0.55) when the volume fraction of glycerol rises to 80%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2 and P4
reference_evidence_units.statement: The reported yields converge to P2 0.48 and P4 0.55.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not assign the comparator's yield to target; neither yield reaches unity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhancement of fluorescence intensities of P2 and P4 can be attributed to TICT inhibition as glycerol is significantly more viscous and less polar than water is.
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2 and P4
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors attribute enhancement to suppression of TICT in more viscous, less polar medium.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Restriction and polarity stabilization effects are not experimentally separated.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The ESA band (II) at 391 nm consists of a double exponential decay profile
reference_evidence_units.subject: P4
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Transient absorption in PBS; main-text description of SI Figure S41.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign the P4 391 nm ESA components to nonemissive TICT (79 ps) and emissive ICT (1.37 ns).
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Transient kinetic assignment is interpretive; SI trace S41 was not personally inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the quantum yields of both P2 and P4 increased substantially (Table S2).
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2 and P4
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DMSO replaces water/glycerol to reduce hydrogen bonding around oxygen.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors report additional quantum-yield improvement in DMSO and retain hydrogen-bond quenching as a contributor.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI Table S2 was not inspected; no numeric DMSO yield is supplied here and no ESIPT is inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: While P4 is also prone to the TICT formation, it exhibited much stronger “TICT resistance”.
reference_evidence_units.subject: P2 and P4
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Combined viscosity, PBS and computed comparisons.
reference_evidence_units.statement: P4 has partial, not complete, TICT resistance relative to P2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Neither compound's fluorescence is attributed solely to one pathway; hydrogen-bond quenching remains.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The viscosity-associated suppression of TICT rotation is the source's motion-level interpretation, with polarity covariation retained.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source assigns nonemissive N-TICT competing with emissive ICT in water, with P4 more resistant than P2.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The explicit competition between nonemissive TICT and emissive ICT populations accounts for yield changes; it overlaps with the primary TICT description.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The viscosity-associated suppression of TICT rotation is the source's motion-level interpretation, with polarity covariation retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific packing, host or matrix mechanism established for the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source assigns nonemissive N-TICT competing with emissive ICT in water, with P4 more resistant than P2.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The explicit competition between nonemissive TICT and emissive ICT populations accounts for yield changes; it overlaps with the primary TICT description.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
